locations.note: After Aldo Trapani is killed in Havana, Michael makes Dominic underboss of the New York family, and he takes over Carmine Rosato's and Tony Rosato's operations.
Dominic bombs the Granados compound and kills Don Rico Granados, takes over Tony's Florida businesses and assassinates Hyman Roth.
The game opens at a meeting of the families in Havana during the Cuban Revolution under Batista.
In the finale Dominic kills Hyman Roth at Miami International Airport.
